title: Missing time on drive home from college

tellings.quote: about 2 and 1 half hours into it suddenly we found oursel in the middle of nowhere didn't know where we were didn't know how we got there and eventually looking at our watch we figured out that somehow we had been asleep for an hour and a half so this was a classic example of missing time

plain: Bob Maguire, a former contractor for the CIA, says that on a drive home from college, about two and a half hours in, he and his companion suddenly found themselves in the middle of nowhere, with no idea where they were or how they got there. He tells it as his own experience, saying their watches showed they had somehow lost an hour and a half, which he calls "a classic example of missing time," the kind of memory gap people link to being taken by aliens.
